name: disp_line
meaning: text line being built for the SUB display
evidence: every row callback writes here; copied to FF3D94.. frame

name: disp_col
evidence: set 5/7/8 before rows; all PUT_LBL use it

name: line_attr
meaning: row style word sent to SUB with the line
evidence: set 0/1/3/0x12 by rows; sub_5314A stores row index

name: cur_flags
meaning: slot flags b0 sent,b1 grp,b3 bln,b4,b7 read

name: cur_frame
meaning: decoded frame shown (10-byte addresses, +0x28 ctl/PID, +0x2A info)

name: disp_info
meaning: pointer to info field of shown frame

name: disp_end
meaning: pointer to end of shown frame

name: aprs_ui
meaning: b0 detail open, b1 compose, b3 alt layout

name: list_hit
meaning: b0 station / b1 message entry present

name: lat_flags
meaning: b7 invalid b6 exact b4 south

name: lon_flags
meaning: b7 invalid b6 exact b4 west b0 +100

name: mice_ns
meaning: Mic-E dest char for N/S (or E/W for lon)

name: mice_lonoff
meaning: Mic-E dest char for +100 lon offset

name: cs_kind
meaning: compressed cs kind 0 alt 1 crs/spd 2 range

name: wx_slot
meaning: pointers g t r p P h b

name: unit_bits
meaning: UNIT: b0 pos fmt b1 dist b3 alt b4 degF b5 inch b6 mph

name: out_msg
meaning: outgoing message record: call A5CD, ssid A5D3, text A5D4
